<!--
The PR title must follow Conventional Commits, e.g. `feat(reactivity): add computed()`.
It's checked by pr-lint.yml and becomes the squash-merge commit subject.
See CONTRIBUTING.md for the accepted types and scopes.
-->

## What

- Short summary of the change

## Why

- Motivation or user value

## How (brief)

- Key implementation notes or decisions

## Testing

- Local and CI coverage; link to tests if relevant

## Risks/Impact

- Compatibility, rollout, performance, security, and any mitigations

## Docs/Follow-ups

- Docs updated, or the next steps left as TODO

Footers go at the bottom of the description, for example:

-->
